name: Cameron Interstate Pipeline
researcher_notes: Not in GEM under any name: checked the 2026-10-02 US gas roster (TransCameron P0269, Creole Trail P0283/P2522/P7797, TETCO Cameron Extension P2509 are different lines). Sempra Infrastructure page says a 40-mile line in Cameron Parish: 36.5 mi of 42 in plus a 3.58 mi 36 in extension, certificated at 2.35 Bcf/d. Mainline length staged as 36.5 mi from Sempra (EIA Aug 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, row 520, says 36.1 mi, 42 in, 2350 MMcf/d, in service Sept 2008, FERC CP05-119). The Federal Register notice of 30 Aug 2006 (Cameron Interstate Pipeline LLC, dockets CP05-119-002) covers the change from 36 in to 42 in plus 1.1 mi more pipe, so the 42 in size is confirmed by a second independent publisher. Sempra and EIA are independent of the FERC notice. Owner is the LLC subsidiary of Sempra Infrastructure; staged to the gazetteer parent name. Endpoint beyond the Cameron LNG terminal end (Holbrook compressor station area, Calcasieu Parish per EIA) not verified, so end location left blank. Route not researched: no official GIS found, left no route. Later projects NOT staged as new rows: 2017 bidirectional expansion (EIA Historical row 849, 3.58 mi of 36 in, CP13-27/CP16-76) is under the 15.5 mi threshold; Holbrook Expansion (EIA row 64, CP24-1, compressor and 1,100 ft header only, 1,079,000 Dth/d, approved, due 2027) adds no new pipe, so monitor for length. Row would be Cameron Interstate Pipeline, mainline, operating.
